items.title: Microsoft Dumps Oracle. Good News: Those Old Chips Renew at a “20% Premium”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle because its older Nvidia chips no longer fit Microsoft’s specifications, Bloomberg reported. Oracle says GPUs renewed last quarter, mostly four years or older, went at a 20% premium, and IREN just recontracted older H100s at double the price.
